deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$MIGRATE_RESET_ONCE" = "1" ]; then echo "MIGRATE_RESET_ONCE is set — resetting database (drops all data!)"; ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate reset --force --schema apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma || exit 1; fi; ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma && node apps/server/dist/index.js'
